info.description: Manage workshop customers and instruments through the versioned v1 API. Browser authentication uses opaque PostgreSQL-backed session cookies; internal resources require an administrator or employee account. API contract versions are independent from this software release version.
info.title: Atelier API

get.description: Filter events using inclusive timezone-aware dates and descending ID pagination.

schema.title: Response List Audit Events Api V1 Audit Events Get

post.description:
Verify credentials and return the account with an opaque HttpOnly cookie.

Session tokens are included only in Set-Cookie, never in the response JSON.
Every successful login rotates the current browser session.
Revoke the cookie's session and clear it even when already absent or revoked.

get.description: Return current account metadata without credentials or session verifiers.

Search names, email and phone using case-insensitive literal substrings.

Omitted or whitespace-only queries list customers. Results are ordered by ID
before applying offset and limit. SQL wildcard characters are treated as text.
Full names can be searched in first-name last-name order.
X-Total-Count reports matching customers before pagination, including for
empty pages. Count and page queries may observe concurrent committed changes.
Archived customers are excluded unless include_archived is true. Direct ID
retrieval and resource associations remain available for historical records.

schema.title: Response Get Customers Api V1 Customers Get

X-Total-Count.description: Number of matching customers before pagination

post.description:
Persist customer details and return the database-generated identifier.

The request commits the new record before refreshing its stored values.

delete.description:
Permanently delete a customer and return an empty response.

Deletion is committed before responding. Repeating the request for the
deleted identifier returns 404.

Args:
    customer_id: The identifier of the customer to delete.
    session: The database session provided for this request.

Returns:
    HTTP 204 with no response body after successful deletion.

Raises:
    HTTPException: With status 404 if the customer does not exist.

get.description:
Return the customer matching the supplied identifier.

Raises:
    HTTPException: With status 404 if the customer does not exist.

patch.description:
Update supplied fields; omitted fields remain unchanged.

Set email or phone to null or blank text to remove it. Names cannot be null.
An empty object returns the existing customer unchanged.

Args:
    customer_id: The identifier of the customer to update.
    customer_update: Validated fields supplied in the request body.
    session: The database session provided for this request.

Returns:
    The complete customer after committing any supplied changes.

Raises:
    HTTPException: With status 404 if the customer does not exist.

Change visibility without removing records, associations or account access.

Repeating the current state is a no-op. Keep the transition and its audit
event in one transaction, serializing concurrent archive/restore requests.

get.description:
Return only instruments currently associated with the customer.

An existing customer without instruments returns an empty list. This is
the current association, not a historical ownership record. Archived instruments
are excluded unless include_archived is true. Unassigned
instruments are excluded. Results have no explicit ordering or pagination.

Raises:
    HTTPException: With status 404 if the customer does not exist.

schema.title: Response Get Customer Instruments Api V1 Customers  Customer Id  Instruments Get

get.description:
Include archived customers and only their currently assigned instruments.

Archived instruments require include_archived=true. Instruments are sorted by ID. An existing customer without instruments has
an empty instrument list; an unknown customer returns 404.

Search identification numbers and combine filters before pagination.

Search uses case-insensitive literal substrings; blank search lists all
matching instruments. Filters are combined with AND. Sorting puts nulls
last and uses ascending ID to resolve ties. Default order is ascending ID.
X-Total-Count includes matches beyond the page, even for empty pages.
Archived instruments are hidden unless include_archived is true.
Count and page queries may observe concurrent committed changes.

schema.title: Response Get Instruments Api V1 Instruments Get

X-Total-Count.description: Number of matching instruments before pagination

post.description:
Store an instrument and return its database-generated identifier.

Omit customer_id or set it to null to register an unassigned instrument.
A supplied identifier must reference an existing customer. The record is
committed before its stored values are returned.

Args:
    instrument: Validated instrument details from the JSON request body.
    session: The database session provided for this request.

Returns:
    The stored instrument, including its identifier and optional fields.

Raises:
    HTTPException: With status 404 if the referenced customer does not exist.

delete.description:
Permanently delete an instrument while preserving its customer.

Deletion is committed before returning an empty response. Repeating the
request for the deleted identifier returns 404.
Instruments referenced by repair history or photographs return 409.

Args:
    instrument_id: The identifier of the instrument to delete.
    session: The database session provided for this request.

Returns:
    HTTP 204 without a response body after successful deletion.

Raises:
    HTTPException: With status 404 if the instrument does not exist.

get.description:
Return the instrument details and its optional associated customer ID.

Unassigned instruments include customer_id as null.

Raises:
    HTTPException: With status 404 if the instrument does not exist.

patch.description:
Update supplied instrument fields and return the complete stored record.

Omitted fields remain unchanged. Set customer_id to null to remove the
association, or supply an existing customer's ID to change it. Optional
details can be cleared with null; type cannot. An empty object is a no-op.

Args:
    instrument_id: The identifier of the instrument to update.
    instrument_update: Validated changes supplied in the JSON request body.
    session: The database session provided for this request.

Returns:
    The complete instrument after committing any supplied changes.

Raises:
    HTTPException: With status 404 if the instrument or customer is missing.
